result:
Personal API tokens are in place: users create and revoke them from the profile page, and scripts call `/api/posts` with `Authorization: Bearer`. `pnpm typecheck` passes. I did not boot the app or call the endpoints over HTTP, so the behaviour is unverified beyond the typecheck.

The changes are in `db/schema.ts` (new `api_tokens` table, with a generated migration in `db/migrations/`), `lib/api-tokens.ts` (token generation, SHA-256 hashing, bearer auth and the per-token limit), `lib/validators.ts`, `routes/api/posts.ts` (GET and POST), `routes/profile/tokens.ts` and `routes/profile/tokens/[id].ts` (create and revoke for signed-in users), and `pages/profile.server.ts` and `pages/profile.tsx` (the token list, create form and revoke buttons). Revocation deletes the row, so a revoked token stops working immediately. The rate limit is a fixed one-minute window stored on each token's row, so a burst straddling a minute boundary can briefly reach up to 120 requests. Also, the `POST /profile/tokens` validator runs before the session check, so a guest who sends an invalid body gets 400 rather than 401; they still get no token.
